# Prep map elements

```{r convert to spatial data}

#-------------------------------
# format grappe data as sf
#-------------------------------
d_sf <- st_as_sf(grappe_gps_mort, coords=c("lon","lat"), 
                 crs=4326) # set coordinate ref system to WGS1984

#-------------------------------
# load administrative boundaries
# downloaded from 
# humanitarian data exchange
# https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-ner?
#-------------------------------
niger_adm0 <- st_read(dsn = paste0(shp_data,"ner_adm00_feb2018/NER_adm00_feb2018.shp"))
niger_adm1 <- st_read(dsn = paste0(shp_data,"ner_adm01_feb2018/NER_adm01_feb2018.shp"))
niger_adm2 <- st_read(dsn = paste0(shp_data,"ner_adm02_feb2018/NER_adm02_feb2018.shp"))

# filter admin level 2 subdistricts to just Dosso and Tahoua
niger_adm2 <- niger_adm2 %>%
  # filter(adm_01 %in% c("Dosso","Tahoua"))
  filter(adm_02 %in% c("Dosso")) ## for initial analysis, just doing Dosso

```

## Spatial predictions of diarrhea and ATE
```{r}

#---------------------------
# identify the bounding box
# around subdistricts that
# contain the WASHB Bangladesh
# clusters
#---------------------------
b_boxgrid <- st_make_grid(niger_adm2,
                          n=c(100,100),
                          what = "centers"
                          )

#-------------------------
# data frame for
# mortality spatial modeling
#-------------------------
grappe_gps_mort

#-------------------------
# fit spatial model for
# diarrhea prevalence in 
# the control group
#-------------------------
b_fitmort <- spaMM::fitme(n_deaths_1to59 ~ 
                            1 +
                            lat + lon + 
                            Matern(1|lat + lon) +
                            (1|adaptive_rand),
                          resid.model = list(formula=~0+
                                               offset(log(pt_year_1to59))
                                             ),
                          data = grappe_gps_mort,
                          family = poisson(link = "log")
                          )

plot_materncor_mort <- plot_matern_corr(b_fitmort)

plot_materncor_mort

ggsave(filename=paste0(figure_path,"avenir-materncor.png"),
       plot=plot_materncor_mort,
       device="png",
       width=3.3,
       height=3.5)
```


```{r}
#--------------------------------------
# get model predictions on a grid
# (see function in washb-geopair-Functions.R)
#--------------------------------------
b_preds_mort <- get_grid_preds(input_grid=b_boxgrid, 
                              spamm_model_fit = b_fitmort)

#--------------------------------------
# convert predicted surface of the mean
# to a raster to make it a regular
# set of tiles (rather than points), 
# then to tibble for ggplot2
# scale prevalence by 100
# to be in units of percent (%)
#--------------------------------------
b_preds_mort_coords <- st_coordinates(b_preds_mort)

b_preds_mort_raster <- points_to_raster(
  x = b_preds_mort_coords[,1],
  y = b_preds_mort_coords[,2],
  z = b_preds_mort$pred*100,
  mask1 = niger_adm2,
  crop1 = niger_adm2
)

b_preds_mort_raster2 <- raster_to_tibble(b_preds_mort_raster)

```



```{r map predictions}

ggplot(data=b_preds_mort_raster2) + 
  geom_sf(data=niger_adm2,fill=NA)

map_mort <- ggplot(data=b_preds_mort_raster2) + 
  geom_tile(aes(x=x,y=y,fill=value), na.rm=TRUE) +
  geom_sf(data=niger_adm2,fill=NA) +
  coord_sf(crs = 4326) +
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "D", direction = 1,
                     # limits = c(0,10),
                        na.value = NA,
                        # breaks = seq(0,10,by=2),
                        guide=guide_colorbar(title="Deaths per 1000", 
                                           title.position = "top",
                                           title.hjust = 0.5,
                                           direction="horizontal",
                                           label.position = "bottom",
                                           label.hjust = 0.5,
                                           barheight=unit(10,"pt"),
                                           barwidth=unit(200,"pt"),
                                           ticks.colour = "white",
                                           ticks.linewidth = 1,
                                           frame.colour = "white"
                        )
                        ) +
  # geom_point(data=dbgps_block, aes(x=lon,y=lat),pch=21,size=2,color="black",fill=NA) +
  # geom_point(data=dbgps_cn,aes(x=lon,y=lat),pch=16,color="gray40",size=0.8) +
  labs(x="Latitude",y="Longitude",tag="a") +
  # annotation_scale(location = "br", width_hint = 0.2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.tag = element_text(face="bold",size=16)
  )

map_mort

ggsave(filename=paste0(figure_path,"avenir-mortality-rate-smoothed-layer-map.png"),
       plot=map_mort,
       device="png",
       width=3.3,
       height=3.5)

```
